quote: we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots
claim: 在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-29重复码，1000个纠错周期、2×10^7次采样，共2×10^10个纠错周期、5.5小时处理器执行时间 [S4.p2]。

quote: we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$
claim: 距离-7表面码的每周期逻辑错误率为(1.43±0.03)×10^-3，错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02 [S2.p5]。

quote: we fine-tune the neural network with processor data and apply a reinforcement learning optimization to the matching graph weights.
claim: 解码方面使用神经网络解码器和集成匹配合成解码器，并通过处理器数据微调神经网络、用强化学习优化匹配图权重 [S2.p2]。

quote: The distance-7 logical qubit lifetime is $291\pm 6$ µs, exceeding the lifetimes of all the constituent physical qubits (median $85\pm 7$ µs, best $119\pm 13$ µs) by a factor of $2.4\pm 0.3$.
claim: 距离-7逻辑量子比特寿命为291±6 µs，超过所有组成物理量子比特寿命（中位数85±7 µs，最佳119±13 µs）的2.4±0.3倍 [S2.p7]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现并验证表面码在物理错误率低于临界阈值时的运行，从而获得随码距增加而指数抑制的逻辑错误率 [S1.p1]。

quote: The cause of this difference is not clear.
claim: 作者指出，DESI BAO数据在0.6<z<0.8红移区间与SDSS结果存在约3σ的差异，原因尚不明确，可能是样本方差波动 [S3.SS3.p4][S3.SS3.p5]。

quote: we caution against over-interpretation of this result, since at least some of the $\left(w_{0},w_{a}\right)$ models preferred by our analysis could be mapped to quintessence models which reproduce the observable quantities $D_{M}/r_{d}$ and $D_{H}/r_{d}$ to high precision even though they do not violate the null energy condition at any redshift
claim: 此外，对w0waCDM结果的解释需谨慎，因为部分偏好模型可能映射到不违反零能量条件的精质模型 [S5.SS2.p9]。

quote: We included in the cosmological inference code cobaya the PantheonPlus, Union3 and DESY5 SN Ia likelihoods, as well as our new DESI BAO likelihoods.
claim: 宇宙学推断使用cobaya中的Metropolis-Hastings MCMC采样，结合CAMB玻尔兹曼代码，并联合外部数据集如BBN、CMB和SN Ia [S2.SS5.p1][S2.SS5.p3]。

quote: in combination with BBN information, further tightens the $H_{0}$ result to $H_{0}=(68.52\pm 0.62)\;\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}\qquad(\mbox{DESI BAO\,+\,BBN\,+\,$\theta_{\ast}$}),$ (19)
claim: 结合BBN和θ*，H0=(68.52±0.62) km/s/Mpc，与SH0ES存在3.7σ张力 [S4.SS1.p4][S6.p2]。

quote: The cause of the difference may simply an unlucky sample variance fluctuation
claim: 作者指出，DESI BAO数据在0.6<z<0.8红移区间与SDSS结果存在约3σ的差异，原因尚不明确，可能是样本方差波动 [S3.SS3.p4][S3.SS3.p5]。

quote: For this work, we generate the SED template at $z\simeq 5$, which excludes both the host galaxy and dust contribution.
claim: 作者构建了一个LRD的SED模型：入射辐射采用去除宿主星系和尘埃贡献的低红移类星体复合SED模板，被延展尘埃介质以类似猎户座星云或AGN环境的灰化消光曲线衰减，取A_V=3 mag，从而在λ>4000 Å产生红光学连续谱、在λ<3000 Å产生平坦紫外形状 [S1.p6][S2.p4][S2.p5]。

quote: For the cases with $n_{0}=10$ and $100~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the SED shapes from the optical band to $\lambda=2-3~\mu{\rm m}$ agree to the observed spectra of LRDs
claim: 红外方面，当密度n0≳10^3 cm^-3或γ=1–2时近红外过亮、与MIRI数据不符；较低密度（n0=10–100 cm^-3）且γ<1时能量峰移向中远红外，与MIRI和ALMA约束一致 [S3.p7][S3.p8][S3.p10]。

quote: Consequently, these results have led to arguments disfavoring the scenario accounting for dust-obscured AGNs.
claim: 作者指出，MIRI观测显示多数LRD在F1800W未被探测、且SED从光学到近红外趋于平坦，这与热尘埃环再发射导致的极红SED预期相矛盾，从而引发对尘埃遮蔽AGN情景的质疑 [S1.p3]。

quote: There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.
claim: 作者承认LRD为何在z>4以统一A_V=3 mag出现尚无明确答案，只能给出推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: As reference, we overlay photometric SED data obtained from stacking LRD samples at $z\sim 5.5$ (orange) and $z=7.5$ (blue).
claim: 作者将模型SED与z~5.5和z=7.5的LRD堆叠测光数据对比，并叠加COSMOS-Web、CEERS、JADES等JWST巡天的5σ点源成像深度 [S2.p5][S2.p9]。

quote: The procedure used in MC event generators to combine the matrix element with a parton-shower algorithm requires special attention in future higher-precision quantum information studies at the LHC.
claim: 此外，蒙特卡洛事件产生器将矩阵元与部分子簇射算法结合的程序在未来LHC更高精度的量子信息研究中需要特别关注 [Ax1.SS10.p7]。

quote: In both of the validation regions, with no entanglement signal, the measurements are found to agree with the predictions from different MC setups within the uncertainties.
claim: 在两个验证区，测量结果与不同蒙特卡洛设置的预言在不确定度内一致，作为对测量方法的一致性检验 [S1.SS4.p1]。

quote: The existence of an entangled state is demonstrated if the measurement satisfies $D<-1/3$, derived from the Peres–Horodecki criterion
claim: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠，通过测量由带电轻子在各自母顶夸克静止系中夹角推断的单一观测量D = −3·⟨cos φ⟩来实现 [S1.p2][S1.p9]。

quote: the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement
claim: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠，通过测量由带电轻子在各自母顶夸克静止系中夹角推断的单一观测量D = −3·⟨cos φ⟩来实现 [S1.p2][S1.p9]。

quote: The optimal mass window for the signal region was determined to be $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV.
claim: 信号区定义为340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV，另设380 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 500 GeV和m_{t\bar{t}} > 500 GeV两个验证区，各区域顶夸克对纯度均超过90% [S1.SS2.p4]。

quote: in the current generation of devices, we anticipate modest energy gaps $\Delta_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle T}}$ and coherence lengths that are not significantly smaller than the device length.
claim: 此外，作者提到在当前器件中，由于有限尺寸效应，预期 E_M 会有显著变化，且拓扑能隙和相干长度并非远小于器件长度 [S4.p7]。

quote: We support this interpretation by reproducing our results with quantum dynamics simulations that incorporate rf drive power, charge noise, and temperature.
claim: 作者还建立了包含 MZM、量子点和环境噪声的有效模型，用量子动力学模拟复现实验结果 [S3.p4][S3.p6]。

quote: $\tau_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle RTS}}$ decreases to half of its value as the bias voltage is increased from $0$ to $90\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro V}$
claim: 准粒子注入使 τ_RTS 减半，而断开量子点与纳米线连接后 RTS 消失，低场下未观察到 h/e 周期性 [S3.p12][S3.p13][S3.p14]。

quote: yielding $n_{\mathrm{qp}}^{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle CPB}}\approx$0.6\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m}$^{-3}$ at $B_{\parallel}=0$.
claim: 驻留时间呈指数分布，特征时间 τ_RTS≈2 ms，对应非平衡准粒子密度约 1 µm⁻³，与 Cooper 对盒独立测量的 0.6 µm⁻³ 在数量级内一致 [S3.p3][S3.p9][S3.p10]。

quote: Protocols for measurement-only topological quantum computation simplify these operations, reducing them to fusion alone.
claim: 论文旨在实现拓扑量子计算中测量-only 方案所需的费米宇称单次测量，即确定一对 Majorana 零能模共享的费米宇称 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: The performance of MACE potentials for determining the melting point can be tested using these approaches, however the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.
claim: 作者指出，通过简单加热晶体结构确定熔点可能并不普遍准确，因为周期性边界条件、小系统尺寸等因素会影响熔点，更可靠的方法如计算固液相自由能、模拟相共存等可用于测试 MACE 势的熔点性能，但这是未来工作 [S3.p3]。

quote: The model is trained upon the MPtrj data set introduced for CHGNet and compiled from the Material Project dataset
claim: MACE 模型基于消息传递神经网络架构，使用高阶多体 ACE 展开，训练于 MPtrj 数据集 [S2.p5]。

quote: deeper minima in MACE systems imply more pronounced solidlike component of the liquid motion.
claim: 在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的速度自相关函数表现出更深的极小值，且两者形状相似，表明液态中类固态振荡成分更显著 [S3.p4]。

quote: Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
claim: 论文旨在评估 MACE-MP-0 机器学习势在计算熔融 LiF 粘度方面的准确性，并与经典 Buckingham 和 BHM 势进行对比 [S1.p4]。

quote: A thorough understanding of the thermodynamic and transport properties of molten salts and their mixtures will underlie the upscaling of the above processes to industrial scales, however this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
claim: 研究动机源于熔融盐在太阳能电池、电解质、核反应堆冷却剂等领域的应用，而对其液态输运性质的理论理解不足，经典原子模型难以生成可靠的热物理数据 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days
claim: 作者使用 Butterpy 生成的模拟光变曲线进行监督训练，并注入真实 Kepler 噪声，训练集为 50000 个模拟样本，按 81%/9%/10% 划分训练、验证和测试集 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: while our model usually gives a sort of ’average’ prediction. It is not clear which result is better in general.
claim: 此外，作者承认在周期发生剧烈变化的光变曲线中，模型通常给出“平均”预测，哪种结果更好尚不明确 [S5.SS2.SSS5.p3]。

quote: For longer periods the correlation is different which might be related to a drop in the activity for older stars.
claim: 对于周期大于 25 天的样本，模拟误差与观测误差的相关性不同，可能与较老恒星活动性下降有关 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2]。

quote: This implies that the model is prior-depended: the distribution of spots in the model has a large effect on the results.
claim: 作者指出，模拟所依赖的 spot 模型存在倾角与 spot 位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验分布，spot 分布对结果影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy
claim: 作者使用 Butterpy 生成的模拟光变曲线进行监督训练，并注入真实 Kepler 噪声，训练集为 50000 个模拟样本，按 81%/9%/10% 划分训练、验证和测试集 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p1]。
